## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.5`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noVueMultipleObjectsInClass`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`vue`](/linter/domains#vue)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`vue/no-multiple-objects-in-class`](https://eslint.vuejs.org/rules/no-multiple-objects-in-class)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueMultipleObjectsInClass": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow more than one object in an array passed to `:class`.

In Vue, an object in a `:class` array adds each of its keys as a class when the
matching value is truthy. Splitting these conditions over several objects in the same
array makes it harder to see which classes depend on which conditions. Put them in a
single object instead.

## Examples

### Invalid

```vue
<template>
  <div :class="[{ active: isActive }, { disabled: isDisabled }]" />
</template>
```

### Valid

```vue
<template>
  <div :class="[{ active: isActive, disabled: isDisabled }]" />
  <div :class="['button', { active: isActive }]" />
  <div :class="{ active: isActive, disabled: isDisabled }" />
</template>
```
